title: P1.2a-0 Track the pairing operator channel that four daemon entrypoints import
description:
Split out of P1.2a (task-bd5c2a0e) by architect-ed72ecfe under that row's own rail "split or reject unrelated pairing WIP; this task owns only the daemon runtime half". The blast radius is wider than the project-manager runtime, so it gets its own row.

Measured at HEAD 445c41ef2858d4b9628e5834a4830217b4e7ef4c: `apps/daemon/src/http/pairing-operator-channel.{ts,js,test.ts}` are all untracked (`??`). Four production modules import it, three of them outside the project-manager runtime:
- apps/daemon/src/daemon-main.ts:11-12
- apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/moe-up-main.ts:11-12
- apps/daemon/src/projects/project-manager-main.ts:53-54
- apps/daemon/src/projects/project-single-main.ts:8-9

daemon-main.ts and moe-up-main.ts are TRACKED. A clean checkout therefore cannot compile the daemon's own main entrypoint or the orchestrator entrypoint, independent of anything in apps/daemon/src/projects. That makes this the deepest prerequisite in the P1.2a chain, not a project-manager detail.

The module is 56 lines and self-contained: it imports nothing, exports PAIRING_OPERATOR_MAX_LINE_BYTES, PairingOperatorInput, PairingOperatorLineHandler and consumePairingOperatorLines, and bounds a foreground operator stream so malformed, overlong and unterminated data is discarded without echo.

Ownership check needed at claim: three pairing rows are live on this epic — P1.1 (task-164fdb12678744c68ffd80c80d69bc9d), task-527bab5d07034a52bbf1a1737f0f801c and task-23dc0910f8f740ceb1bd1c8f5bf69900. None of them named this path in a search at filing time, but that search is stale by the time you claim. Re-measure and adopt, or block on the collision.
